match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: SPOKESPERSON steps into MARA and DEV’s path at the door; after their brief exchange, a cameraman lowers his lens. Framing: medium wide, eye level, Handheld observational frame follows MARA and DEV up the stone steps, with the doorway in the background and the row of cameras edging the frame. Placement only, not the pose: MARA and DEV are climbing the steps together; SPOKESPERSON is not yet in frame. Camera, as one or two arrows: handheld follow up the steps, then settle on the blocked doorway, brisk, unsettled. Characters: DEV, Unspecified, 20s, A young adult reporter of average height, A charcoal casual jacket over a muted crew-neck. MARA, Woman, 40s, An adult woman with a medium build, Green cardigan over a simple light blouse, dark. SPOKESPERSON, Unspecified, 30s–50s, An adult of average height and build, A well-fitted dark business suit, a light button-up. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
